expires_today.title: DIY Halloween Displays and Holiday Gifts
expires_today.description: Make it happen with DIY tech skills!
expires_today.long_description: Unlock an epic collection of Make: ebooks with the all-new DIY Electronics Gadgets, Games, and More Bundle! Start your DIY journey with the Make: Encyclopedia of Electronic Components v1-3, a series of beginner-level reference resources designed to educate newcomers and experienced DIY enthusiasts alike. Or actualize your dreams of creating a mechanical companion with Make: Robotic Arms. Pay what you want for everything you need to build your own DIY tech and help support the Electronic Frontier Foundation with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Best-Sellers of Amigurumi by Meteoor Books
expires_today.long_description: Brighten every shelf, desk, and corner of your home with adorable amigurumi! This craft ebook bundle from Meteoor Books and Amigurumi.com brings you step-by-step patterns for the sweetest crochet creations from whimsical gnomes and magical creatures to endangered animals and forest friends. You'll even find full wardrobes of miniature outfits for four lovable animal friends.  This bundle includes 24 ebooks of amigurumi patterns suitable for beginner and intermediate crafters, so get them now at the price of your choice, and support your favorite charity with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Map Making MEGA Bundle Last Chance
expires_today.description: Chart your own path to map making
expires_today.long_description:
Passionate about building maps to great game worlds? Say hello to the Map Making MEGA Bundle. Whether it's dungeons and floorplans, starships and solar systems or even entire worlds, this treasure trove of assets and apps has what you need for your cartography. It includes practically everything either released by map-making experts ProFantasy Software, including the latest CC3+, Cartographer's Annual Vol. 1–17, every symbol set, dungeon, city and overland app they've ever released.

Map your world and help Save the Children at the same time!

All Humble Bundle customers will get a link to a secret backer level when the Campaign Cartographer 4 Kickstarter is launched. Follow the campaign now!



Keys Expire. Please redeem before November 3, 2027.

expires_today.title: Modern A.I. Game Dev Crash Course
expires_today.description: Your crash course in AI game development
expires_today.long_description:
Buckle up for a crash course in modern AI game development with our latest bundle from the bright minds at Mayfair College. Quickly learn everything you need to leverage AI and build your own games with a gigantic library of university-quality courses like Develop 2D Game UI Using Inkscape, Tic-Tac-Toe Clone - The Complete Cocos2d-x C++ Game Course, and more. Pay what you want for topic-specific learning software and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before November 3rd, 2027.

expires_today.title: Game Dev Mega Cities
expires_today.description: Build next-gen mega cities with 500+ Assets!
expires_today.long_description:
A game is nothing without a detailed environment to play around in, and this bundle from KitBash3D has everything you need to create the sprawling urban worlds and towering sci-fi skylines of your dreams! The assets included here are packed with detailed environments, production-ready construction materials, and futuristic vehicles, giving game developers the building blocks to create dense streets, industrial districts, and high-tech worlds with scale and atmosphere. All software is compatible with Blender, Unreal, and more. Pay what you want for a library of city-building assets, and support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before December 2, 2026.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Factory Must Grow
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The factories are open for business. This construction-focused bundle offers builder-style games with a wide range of flavors, ranging from complex space expeditions to cozy, relaxing island sims. Strap on your helmet for Eden Crafters, the ultimate open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform far-off planets into close-knit communities; terraform a dying planet back to health in Blossom: The Seed of Life; or try Oddsparks for a unique blend of automation and real-time strategy! Pay what you want for great games and help support TD Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Java by Apress
expires_tomorrow.description: Find your groove with Java by Apress.
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Level up your tech skills before fall takes form with our latest Java Mastery Bundle by Apress. Flip the script on your job prospects and learn how to speak standard languages used by computer experts, create efficient agentic assistants, and more with approachable lessons like Pro Spring Boot 4: An Authoritative Guide with Best Practices and Go for Java Programmers: Learn Google's Go Programming Language. Start a new career in tech or sharpen your existing toolset, and help support No Kid Hungry with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: Hamble's Fright or Fight Halloween Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Spooky season calls for Humble’s Fright or Flight Halloween Bundle! Leave the lights on for Blair Witch, a story-driven psychological horror experience based on the cinematic lore of the iconic Blair Witch franchise. Explore the real world and spiritual realm as the protagonist of The Medium in a gripping, horror-filled exploration of your past traumas, or call your friends and gobble up DEVOUR, the 1 to 4-player horror survival game where you’ll stop cultists from carrying out their wicked plans. Enjoy frightening savings on the hottest horror games, and help support the WDC with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Unity Powerhouse Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Make video games that look like they took years to design—in no time at all! With this massive collection of tools and assets for Unity, you can fill your games with detail and atmosphere and have them ready to play before you know it. Build complete game worlds with ready-to-use characters, environments, biomes, and props. Explore collections of terrain and environment stamps, design ready-to-use industrial cityscapes, experiment with dynamic lighting and fog effects, and more! Create, experiment, prototype, and bring your ideas to life with a wide variety of production-ready Unity assets, many of which have never been featured in a Humble Bundle before! Get this huge bundle of assets for the price of your choosing, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 31, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Complete Java Developer Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Whether you’re a seasoned software developer or just getting the hang of a couple programming languages, this bundle of training resources has everything you need to master Java! Learn hands-on tactics for designing CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, master the basics of Java Spring Framework and Selenium WebDriver, find out how to problem-solve and troubleshoot with data structures and algorithms, and more! This bundle of over 25 training course packages is perfect for those who simply need a Java refresher or anyone who’s just starting out! Grab this bundle now at the price of your choice, and support ocean ecosystem charity Coral Guardian with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 28th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Beyond Reality: Sci-Fi & Survival VR Collection
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Blast off to faraway stars or stay home and hide from monsters in the woods with this bundle of sci-fi and horror (and sci-fi horror) VR games! Explore a derelict spaceship while fighting off an entity determined to mutate your own body in Star Trek: Infection! Command a fleet of ships through evolving stages of space battles in Homeworld: Vast Reaches! Run through the woods finding stick figures and hiding from a creature of terror and darkness in Blair Witch VR! Fully immerse yourself in outer space adventures and Earthbound terror with these VR games! Get them all now at the price of your choice and support HPV Cancers Alliance with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 28th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: The Dynamite Trick-or-Treat Bundle by Dynamite
expires_within_72h.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Celebrate the spooky season with this giant bundle of Halloween one-shots and horror series from Dynamite! Watch Ash Williams attempt to hold down a job while battling legions of Deadites in Ash vs. The Army of Darkness! Follow Vampirella on her hunt for a terrifying serial killer in Vampirella Halloween Horror! Celebrate the Festival of the Dead with Red Sonja and solve an outer space mystery with Bette Page in the heroines’ Halloween One-Shots! Get up to 98 comics in this trick-or-treat bundle—heavy on the treats! Pay what you want and support the Hero Initiative!

expires_within_72h.title: Premium Assets: Unreal Game Dev Collection
expires_within_72h.description: Step into your own Unreal worlds.
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Let’s build video games! Create your next project with one of the most powerful and approachable engines on the market with the Unreal Game Dev Collection, a curated bundle by our favorite publishers that offers detailed assets for developers of all levels. Quickly establish settings with the Barcelona Square Environment, the Riverside European Village Environment, or The Bone Temple. Then, fill your worlds with realistic vehicles, powerful spells, and so much more. Get the assets you need to help bring your game to life, and help support DonorsChoose with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before October 15th, 2027.
